situation: An import is staged before anything is written
given: a Staff Member holding import.run at a Property they reach
when: they upload a file and its rows are read
then: an import is recorded as staged with them as its uploader, its kind, its file's name and its rows, each ready, already there or wrong; no room, booking or Guest exists yet. Who uploaded it and its state are the database's, not the caller's
test_name: guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-01: a manager stages an import and nothing else is written; guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-01: its rows arrive ready, wrong or already there; guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-01: and no room exists yet; guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-01: the uploader and the state are stamped, whatever the caller sent

situation: Only import.run imports
given: a front desk without import.run, a housekeeper, and a manager of another Property
when: each stages an import at the Property
then: refused (42501) by the insert policy; the owner and the manager of that Property are not
test_name: guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-02: an owner and a manager hold import.run, and no other role of the product; guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-02: a front desk without import.run stages nothing; guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-02: nor a manager who does not reach the Property; guided-import.test.ts: IMP-S1-02: a front desk without import.run previews nothing

situation: Another Organization sees nothing
given: an import at one Organization
when: a Staff Member of another Organization reads imports and their rows
then: no row is returned and none can be written
test_name: guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-03: another Organization reads no import and no row; guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-03: and stages none in this one; guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-03: both tables force their policies on their owner too

situation: The rows are the uploader's alone
given: an import and another holder of import.run at the same Property
when: the other reads the import and its rows
then: they read the import: who, when, the file's name and the counts. They read none of its rows, which hold what the file held (identity numbers in slice 2)
test_name: guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-04: another holder of import.run reads the import and none of its rows; import-detail.test.tsx: IMP-S1-12: somebody else's running import offers Stop and never Carry on, and shows none of its rows

situation: An import does only what its uploader could do by hand
given: a Staff Member holding import.run and not accommodation.configure
then: every row is refused by accommodation's own policy and settles as refused with that reason; no room is added. The import has no way into the database of its own
test_name: guided-import.test.ts: IMP-S1-05: an importer who may not add rooms adds none through an import

situation: Starting needs a ready row
given: a staged import whose rows are all wrong or already there
then: refused (RZI01): there is nothing to import. The screen offers the rows to fix instead of the button
test_name: guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-06: an import with no ready row does not start; guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-06: its uploader starts an import with ready rows

situation: One import runs at a Property at a time
given: an import in progress at a Property
when: a second one is started there
then: refused (23505) by a partial unique index; staging and previewing a second one is allowed. Two people starting at once end with one import running
test_name: guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-07: a second import does not start at a Property while one is running; guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-07: the next import starts once the one before it has finished; guided-import.test.ts: IMP-S1-07: a second import does not start while one is running, and IMP-S1-12: anybody who imports there may stop it; import-detail.test.tsx: IMP-S1-07: a start refused because another import is running says so and says what to do

situation: A row is settled once and only forwards
given: an import in progress
when: its uploader settles a ready row, then settles it again, then settles a wrong row
then: a ready row becomes imported, already there or refused, with what it made; a settled row and a wrong row cannot be settled (RZI02); a row of a staged, finished or discarded import cannot be settled
test_name: guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-08: a row does not arrive already imported; guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-08: no row is settled before the import starts; guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-08: a ready row is settled once; guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-08: a wrong row is never imported; guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-08: and its counts are moved by nobody who does not reach it

situation: The last row finishes the import
given: an import in progress with one ready row left
then: the import is finished, stamped with when, and its counts are the rows' own: imported, already there, refused, wrong
test_name: guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-09: an import with a ready row left is still importing; guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-09: settling the last ready row finishes the import with the counts of its rows; guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-09: the counts are the rows

situation: Only the uploader carries an import on
given: an import in progress and another holder of import.run
then: refused (42501): only the person who uploaded an import starts it or settles its rows, so every room it makes is made under their session and its audit names them. Anybody who may import at the Property may still stop it (IMP-S1-12)
test_name: guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-10: nobody starts somebody else's import; guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-10: nobody settles a row of somebody else's import

situation: A closed tab pauses and never loses
given: an import in progress whose page was closed after forty of a hundred rows
when: its uploader opens it again and carries on
then: the page asks for the next twenty ready rows at a time, each made by the same command and session as by hand and settled the moment it answers, so a closed tab only pauses: the forty stay imported, the sixty are imported when it carries on, and a room made but not yet settled when the tab closed settles as already there by its unique name, never twice
test_name: guided-import.test.ts: IMP-S1-11: an import carried on after a pause imports the rest and nothing twice; import-detail.test.tsx: IMP-S1-11: pressing Import asks for batch after batch until the import is no longer importing; import-detail.test.tsx: IMP-S1-11: an import a closed page paused offers to carry on, and to stop

situation: Stopping leaves the rest unimported
given: an import in progress
when: its uploader or another holder of import.run at the Property stops it
then: it is finished, every row still ready is marked left unimported, and what was imported stays. A stopped import frees the Property for the next one
test_name: guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-12: a stopped import is finished and its ready rows are left unimported; guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-12: another holder of import.run may stop it; guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-12: and a stopped import frees the Property for the next one; guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-12: a row is not left unimported while its import is still running; guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-12: an import is closed by somebody who reaches it or by the worker, and by nobody else

situation: Discarding a preview
given: a staged import
then: it is discarded and its rows are left unimported; a discarded or finished import cannot be started (RZI01)
test_name: guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-13: its uploader discards a preview; guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-13: and its rows are left unimported; guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-13: a discarded import cannot be started

situation: An import is never deleted or rewound
given: an import in any state
when: anyone, the owner of the table included, deletes it or moves it backwards
then: refused: finished and discarded are final (RZI01) and no import is deleted (42501)
test_name: guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-14: a finished import is not reopened; guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-14: nor moved backwards; guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-14: an import is never deleted; guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-14: an import is not deleted by the owner either

situation: The rows are forgotten after seven days
given: an import finished eight days ago, one staged eight days ago and one in progress untouched for eight days
then: the rows of each are deleted; the staged one is discarded and the one in progress is finished, so neither blocks the Property; the import itself and its counts stay. One finished six days ago is untouched
test_name: guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-15: the sweep forgets rows older than seven days and keeps the counts; guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-15: and leaves a younger import alone; guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-15: only the worker runs the sweep; guided_import.test.sql: IMP-S1-15: the sweep forgets nothing outside a worker context; guided-import.test.ts: IMP-S1-15: the worker forgets the rows after seven days and the counts stay

situation: An import is audited
given: an import started and finished
then: import.started and import.finished are there with the uploader, the Property, the kind, the file's name and the counts; no cell of the file is in either
test_name: guided-import.test.ts: IMP-S1-16: starting and finishing are audited with counts and no cell of the file

situation: A file is read whatever its locale
given: an xlsx and a csv, comma or semicolon separated, with or without a byte order mark, headed in Turkish, English or Arabic
then: its first sheet's header row is matched to the columns in any of the three languages, ignoring case, accents and spaces; a column nobody recognises is offered for matching and otherwise ignored
test_name: import-read.test.ts: IMP-S1-17: a semicolon-separated file with a byte order mark is read; import-read.test.ts: IMP-S1-17: a comma-separated file and a Turkish code page are read too; import-read.test.ts: IMP-S1-17: headers are matched in Turkish, English and Arabic; import-read.test.ts: IMP-S1-17: a column nobody recognises is offered for matching and otherwise ignored; guided-import.test.ts: IMP-S1-17: a heading nobody recognises is asked about, and the answer is used; guided-import.spec.ts: IMP-S1-17: a heading nobody recognises is asked about, and answered once

situation: A file that cannot be an import is refused when it is uploaded
given: an empty file, a header with no row under it, a file with no header that matches, one over 2 MB or 2000 rows, a protected workbook
then: each is refused with its own reason before any preview and nothing is recorded. A workbook with several sheets is read from its first, and the page says so
test_name: import-read.test.ts: IMP-S1-18: an empty file, a header alone and an unrecognised header are each refused by name; import-read.test.ts: IMP-S1-18: a file over the row limit is refused; guided-import.spec.ts: IMP-S1-18: a file that cannot be an import is refused with its own reason

situation: A room row is checked before it is written
given: a file of rooms with a room number that is not digits, a floor out of range, a capacity of zero, a bed-let suite, an unknown word for whom it admits, and the same room twice
then: each such row is wrong, with the column and the reason; the second of two rows for one room is wrong as a duplicate of the first; yes and no, and whom a room admits, are read in all three languages
test_name: import-rooms.test.ts: IMP-S1-19: each wrong cell of a room row is named with its column; import-rooms.test.ts: IMP-S1-19: yes and no, and whom a room admits, are read in all three languages; import-rooms.test.ts: IMP-S1-19: the same room twice in one file is a duplicate; import-rooms.test.ts: IMP-S1-19: an empty let-by-the-bed is the Property's default, for a room only

situation: A room already at the Property is never overwritten
given: a file naming a room the Property already has
then: the row is already there at the preview and nothing about the existing room changes; a room added by somebody else between the preview and the import settles as already there, decided by the unique name (RB-S2-06)
test_name: import-rooms.test.ts: IMP-S1-20: a room the Property already has is already there, and the rest are ready or wrong; guided-import.test.ts: IMP-S1-20: a room the Property already has is skipped and left as it was

situation: The same file twice adds nothing twice
given: a file of rooms imported once
when: it is uploaded and imported again
then: every row is already there at the preview, there is nothing to import and no room is doubled
test_name: guided-import.test.ts: IMP-S1-21: the same file a second time has no ready row

situation: A room is added as if by hand
given: a ready row for a four-bed room on a floor of a building that admits women
then: the room exists with its building, floor, capacity and whom it admits, with beds A to D under it when it is let by the bed, and the audit names the uploader as for any room added on the Rooms screen
test_name: import-rooms.test.ts: IMP-S1-22: a row becomes the room accommodation's command takes; guided-import.test.ts: IMP-S1-22: an imported room has its beds and is audited to its uploader

situation: The preview says what will happen
given: a staged import with ready, already-there and wrong rows
then: the counts of each are stated, wrong rows come first with the cell and reason beside them, and the button names how many rows it will import; with none ready there is no button and the rows to fix are offered
test_name: guided-import.spec.ts: IMP-S1-23: a manager uploads rooms, sees every row before anything is written, and imports the ready ones; import-detail.test.tsx: IMP-S1-23: a preview puts the rows to fix first, each reason on its own line, and names how many rooms the button adds; import-detail.test.tsx: IMP-S1-23: with no row ready there is no button to press, and the page says what to do

situation: Import is offered where the thing is
given: the Rooms screen with no room and with many
when: a holder of import.run opens it
then: an empty Property offers Import beside Add rooms in its empty state, and a Property with rooms offers it in the page's actions; somebody without import.run sees neither, and the address typed by hand says they cannot import and offers the way back
test_name: rooms-view.test.tsx: IMP-S1-24: importing from a file is offered beside adding rooms, and only where it leads somewhere; guided-import.spec.ts: IMP-S1-24: Rooms offers the import, and somebody who may not import finds no way in

situation: The result is a file
given: a finished import
then: an Excel workbook of every row with its outcome and reason in the viewer's language, and a second with only the rows to fix in the template's own columns, ready to correct and upload again; after seven days the page says the rows have been forgotten and offers no file
test_name: import-report.test.ts: IMP-S1-25: every row is in the result with its own number and outcome; import-report.test.ts: IMP-S1-25: the rows to fix come back in the template's columns with the reason; import-report.test.ts: IMP-S1-25: with nothing to fix it is the headings alone; import-detail.test.tsx: IMP-S1-25: a finished import offers both files and the way to Rooms, and only a way the viewer may take; import-detail.test.tsx: IMP-S1-25: once the rows are forgotten the page says so and offers no file

situation: The template is in the viewer's language
given: a viewer in Turkish, English or Arabic
then: its headers are in their language with one example row, and uploading it unchanged previews that row as ready
test_name: import-read.test.ts: IMP-S1-26: the template in each language reads back as one ready row

situation: It reads in three languages and mirrors
given: the import page in Turkish, English and Arabic
then: every label, reason and count is in that language with its plural, and in Arabic the page mirrors
test_name: guided-import.spec.ts: IMP-S1-27: the import page reads in Arabic and mirrors, and in Turkish

situation: Past imports are listed
given: a Property with no import, one and many
when: a holder of import.run opens Import
then: none says so and offers the template; each import shows who, when, its file's name, its state and counts, newest first; one in progress by somebody else offers Stop and not Carry on
test_name: guided-import.test.ts: IMP-S1-28: past imports are listed newest first, each with its uploader and counts; guided-import.spec.ts: IMP-S1-23: a manager uploads rooms, sees every row before anything is written, and imports the ready ones; import-detail.test.tsx: IMP-S1-12: somebody else's running import offers Stop and never Carry on, and shows none of its rows

situation: A person row books a bed
given: a ready row naming a person, a room and bed, and the nights
then: the Guest is recorded or matched and the booking taken by reservations' own command, as a Resident where the Property is a dormitory and the row does not say otherwise; the exclusion constraint decides whether the bed is free
test_name: guided-import.test.ts: IMP-S2-01: a person row books the bed through the booking command; guided-import.spec.ts: IMP-S2-01: an owner imports people into the rooms already there, and is led to Registrations

situation: A person already on file is reused and not edited
given: a row whose exact email matches a Guest of the Organization, and two rows in one file with the same identity number
then: the booking is added to the Guest the email names, as the booking command does by hand, and nothing on that Guest is overwritten (ADR 0024); the second row with the same identity number is wrong as a duplicate. Matching a Guest already on file by identity number is IMP-DEF-06
test_name: guided-import.test.ts: IMP-S2-02: a person on file is matched by exact email and not edited; import-people.test.ts: IMP-S2-02: one identity number twice in a file is a duplicate

situation: A bed already promised refuses the row
given: a row for a bed taken over those nights
then: wrong at the preview when the preview can see it; taken between preview and import, the row settles as refused and the others go on
test_name: guided-import.test.ts: IMP-S2-03: a bed taken since the preview refuses its row and no other

situation: A room does not admit them
given: a row for a man in a room that admits women
then: the row is wrong and the import offers no override; the desk's own override with a reason stays at the desk
test_name: guided-import.test.ts: IMP-S2-04: a person the room does not admit is a wrong row

situation: Whoever already lives there is checked in
given: a row whose first night is before the Property's own today, and one whose first night is today or later
then: a booking cannot start before today and is not taken on a closed day (reservations' own rules, unchanged), so the first is booked from the Property's today and checked in at once, and the first night the file gave is kept in the import's result; the second is a booking only. Today is the Property's business date, not the uploader's clock (ADR 0021). Booking the nights before the import is IMP-DEF-07
test_name: guided-import.test.ts: IMP-S2-05: a row begun before the Property's today is booked from today and checked in, and a later one is not

situation: Dates are read or refused
given: 31.12.2026, 2026-12-31, a spreadsheet's own date cell and 03/04/2026
then: the first three are the date they say; the last is wrong as ambiguous, and is never guessed
test_name: import-people.test.ts: IMP-S2-06: a day-first and an ISO date are read; import-people.test.ts: IMP-S2-06: an ambiguous date is wrong

situation: Booking and particulars need the desk's permission
given: an importer who holds import.run and not front_desk.book
then: every row is refused as not permitted and nothing is recorded: the booking and the particulars, the identity document among them, are recorded under front_desk.book by the database (ADR 0058), as by hand, and an import has no other way in; the screen does not offer such an importer a people file to upload, and says why, while rooms stay open to them
test_name: guided-import.test.ts: IMP-S2-07: an importer who may not take bookings books nobody and records no particulars; guided-import.spec.ts: IMP-S2-07: somebody who may import and may not book finds why, and rooms still open

situation: A bed is booked at the price the desk would quote
given: a ready row for a bed with a price list, and one with none
then: the bed's nightly price is quoted as the booking dialog quotes it and the booking is taken at that quote (ADR 0038); one with no price is taken unpriced, as by hand; a price changed between the quote and the booking refuses the row as the price having changed, and the others go on; a Resident is never priced by the night (reservations_resident_is_not_priced_by_the_night), so a Resident is quoted nothing and booked unpriced, as the dialog books them
test_name: guided-import.test.ts: IMP-S2-08: a bed is booked at its quoted price, and an unpriced one unpriced

situation: Why a row is wrong stays in view on a phone
given: a preview with a wrong row, on a screen narrower than the row's cells
then: each row's outcome and the reason come before its cells, so the cells scroll sideways and the reason does not; the columns nobody filled are left off the table and kept in the files
test_name: guided-import.spec.ts: IMP-S2-01: an owner imports people into the rooms already there, and is led to Registrations

situation: A plan starts from today
given: a row with a total and a number of instalments
then: the plan is made by payment plans' own command with instalments due from the Property's today on, none after the last night (ADR 0059)
test_name: guided-import.test.ts: IMP-S3-01: an imported plan has no instalment before the Property's today

situation: A balance carried over is one line
given: a row with a balance owed
then: one Folio line carries it, labelled as carried over, by the Folio's own command and permission; no payment history is imported
test_name: guided-import.test.ts: IMP-S3-02: a balance owed is one carried-over line on the Folio

situation: Money is the Property's currency
given: 1.250,00, 1250.00 and an amount with another currency's sign
then: the first two are 1250.00 in the Property's currency; the third is wrong
test_name: import-people.test.ts: IMP-S3-03: an amount in another currency is wrong

situation: Undoing a whole import
given: an import finished by mistake
then: deferred: an honest undo must refuse once anything imported has been acted on, which is a feature of its own. Until then the result lists what was made and each record is corrected by its own command

situation: Staff, equipment and payment history
given: a file of Staff Members, of equipment or of past payments
then: deferred: slice 1 to 3 import rooms and people; history is carried as one balance (IMP-S3-02)

situation: The setup checklist
given: a new Organization
then: deferred: blueprint 19.2's checklist with owners and evidence is its own feature; import is one of its steps

situation: Inviting every imported Resident to the Portal
given: an import of Residents with emails
then: deferred: nothing sends email or SMS yet; each Resident is invited from their booking (ADR 0060)

situation: Rooms numbered with letters
given: a file whose room is A-101 or Z03
then: deferred: a room number is digits and the building is its own column (RB-S2-*), so A-101 is building A, room 101; a number with letters is a wrong row until rooms themselves allow one

situation: Matching a Guest on file by identity number
given: a row whose identity number is that of a Guest already on file
then: deferred: nothing looks a Guest up by document number today, and such a lookup answers whether anybody with that number is on file, which ADR 0058 keeps behind the permission to read documents. It needs its own decision; until then a Guest is matched by exact email

situation: Booking the nights before the import
given: a Resident who moved in before the import
then: deferred: a booking cannot start before the Property's today or on a closed day, and changing that is a decision about reservations, not import. The nights already lived are carried as a balance (IMP-S3-02), and the first night the file gave stays in the import's result
